issues.title: IndexError when subtracting two empty DataFrames
issues.body: When calling `df1.sub(df2)` with both DataFrames empty, a cryptic IndexError is thrown. The expected behaviour is an empty DataFrame. Stack trace attached.

issues.title: Race condition in cache invalidation during login
issues.body: Under high load, two simultaneous login requests can cause the Redis cache to become stale. The session token is sometimes overwritten. We need a distributed lock around invalidation.

issues.title: NullPointerException when user profile picture is missing
issues.body: If a user's profile picture field is None in the database, the frontend crashes with a NullPointerException. We should add a default avatar fallback.

issues.title: Memory leak in Celery worker when handling large payloads
issues.body: The Celery worker process slowly grows in memory after processing batches of large JSON payloads. Possible cause: unreleased references in the task result backend.

issues.title: Timeout when fetching large paginated API responses
issues.body: The `/api/items?page=1000` endpoint times out after 30 seconds. The database query uses `OFFSET` which becomes slow on high pages. Should switch to keyset pagination.

issues.title: Add pagination support to the search results page
issues.body: The search results currently return all matches at once, which is unusable for large datasets. We need to add infinite scroll with cursor‑based pagination.

issues.title: Implement caching layer for user profile endpoint
issues.body: The `/api/user/profile` endpoint is called on every page load and hits the database each time. Add a Redis cache with a 5‑minute TTL to reduce load.

issues.title: Support batch operations in the inventory API
issues.body: Currently the inventory API only allows single‑item updates. We need a bulk endpoint to update hundreds of items atomically.

issues.title: Add Prometheus metrics exposure for Celery tasks
issues.body: We want to monitor task success/failure rates and queue lengths. Integrate `celery-prometheus-exporter` and expose a `/metrics` endpoint.

issues.title: Enable OAuth2 login with GitHub
issues.body: Our application only supports email/password. Add social login via GitHub OAuth using the `django-allauth` package.

issues.title: Reduce Docker image size from 1.2GB to under 300MB
issues.body: The current Docker image is bloated because it includes build dependencies and the entire Python cache. Use multi‑stage builds and `pip install --no-cache-dir`.

issues.title: Improve test coverage for authentication module
issues.body: The `auth` module has only 42% test coverage. We need unit tests for password reset, email verification, and token refresh endpoints.

issues.title: Sensitive data exposure in error responses
issues.body: When a database connection fails, the stack trace includes the database hostname and username. We must sanitise error responses in production mode.

issues.title: Missing rate limiting on login endpoint
issues.body: The `/login` endpoint can be brute‑forced because there is no per‑IP rate limiting. Implement a token‑bucket rate limiter using Redis.

issues.title: Arbitrary file read via path traversal in file upload
issues.body: By sending a filename like `../../etc/passwd`, an attacker can read arbitrary files on the server. Sanitise user‑supplied filenames and restrict upload paths.

issues.title: Outdated TLS version used in production
issues.body: The server still accepts TLS 1.0 and 1.1 connections. We must update the nginx configuration to only allow TLS 1.2+.

issues.title: Missing docstrings for public API functions
issues.body: Several public methods in `api/v1/views.py` lack docstrings. This makes onboarding new contributors painful. Add Google‑style docstrings.

issues.title: Outdated example in README for Docker Compose
issues.body: The README still references `docker-compose` (v1) command, but we now use `docker compose` (v2). Update the example to match the current setup.

issues.title: API reference for v2 endpoints is incomplete
issues.body: The `/v2/` endpoints added three months ago have not been documented. We need to add OpenAPI annotations and regenerate the Swagger UI.

issues.title: Add tutorial for deploying on Kubernetes
issues.body: We have a Helm chart but no step‑by‑step guide for first‑time users. Write a tutorial that covers ingress, secrets, and database migration.

issues.title: Fix datetime localization in reporting
issues.body: Timezone conversion in the weekly report ignores DST, causing off‑by‑one errors in scheduled emails.

issues.title: Database deadlock when updating inventory counts
issues.body: Two concurrent transactions on `inventory` and `orders` tables occasionally deadlock. We need to change the lock ordering.

issues.title: CORS misconfiguration blocks legitimate API requests
issues.body: Our frontend (different subdomain) gets blocked by CORS after the last release. The `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` header is too strict.

issues.title: Slow query on dashboard when filtering by date
issues.body: The `SELECT ... WHERE created_at BETWEEN` query takes >2s on large tables. An index on `created_at` is missing.

issues.title: Parallelise image processing using multiprocessing
issues.body: Image thumbnails are generated sequentially in a loop. Swap to `multiprocessing.Pool` to utilise multiple cores.

issues.title: Use connection pooling for Redis
issues.body: Every request creates a new Redis connection. Implement connection pooling with `redis-py` to reduce overhead.

issues.title: Profile memory usage and eliminate hot spots
issues.body: The application consumes 800MB RAM under normal load. Run `memory_profiler` and identify objects that can be freed.

issues.title: Stream large file downloads instead of buffering
issues.body: The download endpoint loads the entire file into memory before sending. Switch to streaming response for files >10MB.

issues.title: Implement two‑factor authentication
issues.body: Add support for TOTP‑based 2FA using `pyotp`. Backup codes should be generated on first setup.

issues.title: JWT token can be replayed after logout
issues.body: Even after logout, the JWT access token remains valid until expiry. We need a token blacklist on Redis.

issues.title: Add dark mode support to the dashboard
issues.body: Our users have been requesting a dark theme for late‑night work. Implement a theme toggle using CSS variables and Tailwind.

issues.title: Migrate from Webpack to Vite for faster builds
issues.body: Cold start times with Webpack exceed 45 seconds. Vite offers near‑instant dev server starts. Update the build configuration.

issues.title: Fix broken pagination on mobile view
issues.body: The pagination component overflows on screens narrower than 360px. Adjust the layout to use a simpler prev/next pattern on small screens.

issues.title: Improve accessibility of modal dialogs
issues.body: Our modals don't trap focus and the close button is not keyboard‑accessible. Update to use the WAI‑ARIA dialog pattern.

issues.title: Add loading skeleton to dashboard widgets
issues.body: Widgets flash an empty state before data loads. Replace with animated placeholder cards (skeleton loading).

issues.title: Replace moment.js with dayjs to reduce bundle size
issues.body: moment.js adds ~230KB to our bundle. Since we only need simple date formatting, switching to dayjs will save significant space.

issues.title: Set up automated dependency updates with Renovate
issues.body: Manually checking for package updates is error‑prone. Configure Renovate to open PRs for outdated npm and pip dependencies.

issues.title: Add i18n support for the frontend
issues.body: We are expanding to non‑English markets. Integrate `react-intl` and extract all user‑facing strings into translation files.

issues.title: Fix flaky integration test in CI
issues.body: `test_order_creation` fails randomly with a timeout. Investigate and add proper waiting conditions or increase the timeout.

issues.title: Add rate‑limiting middleware to all API endpoints
issues.body: Currently only the login endpoint is rate‑limited. We need a global rate limiter to protect against abuse.

issues.title: Create Storybook stories for UI components
issues.body: Our design system lacks a living style guide. Set up Storybook and add stories for Button, Input, Card, and Dialog components.

issues.title: Optimise re‑renders in the user list component
issues.body: The user list re‑renders completely on any state change. Use `React.memo` and `useCallback` where appropriate.

issues.title: Add changelog generation to the release workflow
issues.body: Manually writing release notes is tedious. Automate changelog generation from merged PR labels using `release-drafter`.

issues.title: Replace hardcoded strings with environment variables
issues.body: API keys and database URLs are hardcoded in `settings.py`. Move them to environment variables with sensible defaults.

issues.title: Add end‑to‑end tests with Cypress
issues.body: We have no e2e tests. Set up Cypress and write tests for the login, registration, and dashboard flows.

issues.title: Fix inconsistent button styling across pages
issues.body: The primary button has different padding and border radius on the settings page compared to the rest of the app.

issues.title: Add keyboard shortcuts for common actions
issues.body: Power users want shortcuts like `Ctrl+Enter` to submit forms and `Esc` to close modals. Implement a global shortcut listener.

issues.title: Set up Sentry for frontend error tracking
issues.body: Our backend is already monitored via Sentry, but frontend errors go unreported. Integrate `@sentry/react` with source maps.

issues.title: Move hardcoded routes to a constants file
issues.body: URLs are scattered across components. Centralise all routes in `routes.js` to make changes easier.

issues.title: Upgrade Python from 3.8 to 3.11
issues.body: Python 3.8 is nearing EOL. Upgrade the runtime and update Docker images, CI config, and documentation.

issues.title: Model accuracy drops by 5% when batch size > 256
issues.body: Training with batch sizes larger than 256 causes a noticeable drop in validation accuracy. Suspected issue with batch normalisation statistics.

issues.title: Add support for mixed‑precision training
issues.body: Many modern GPUs support float16 operations. Implement automatic mixed precision (AMP) to speed up training and reduce memory usage.

issues.title: Document the hyperparameter tuning guide
issues.body: New users often struggle to find optimal hyperparameters. Write a tutorial covering grid search, random search, and Bayesian optimisation using our built‑in tools.

issues.title: Fix memory leak in Keras model saving
issues.body: When saving a Keras model using `model.save()`, memory consumption spikes and never fully releases. Profiling points to a TensorFlow graph caching issue.

issues.title: Add ONNX export for scikit‑learn pipelines
issues.body: Our scikit‑learn pipelines cannot be exported to ONNX for deployment. Implement a converter that handles preprocessing and model steps.

issues.title: Improve error message when data shape is incorrect
issues.body: Passing a 1D array where a 2D array is expected gives a cryptic `ValueError`. Add a more descriptive message with the expected shape.

issues.title: Add built‑in support for TensorBoard logging
issues.body: We currently only support console logging. Integrate TensorBoard writer so users can visualise training curves without extra code.

issues.title: Fix incorrect predictions when using GPU inference
issues.body: Models loaded on GPU produce slightly different predictions compared to CPU, even with the same input. Likely a floating‑point precision issue.

issues.title: Parallelise cross‑validation using joblib
issues.body: Cross‑validation currently runs sequentially. Replace the loop with `joblib.Parallel` to utilise multiple cores.

issues.title: Add BERT‑based text classification example
issues.body: Our example gallery lacks a modern NLP example. Add a Jupyter notebook that fine‑tunes `bert-base-uncased` on the IMDB dataset.

issues.title: Fix `KeyError` when accessing missing column in DataFrame
issues.body: When a column name is misspelled, the library crashes with an unhelpful `KeyError`. Catch the error and suggest similar column names.

issues.title: Support for large datasets that don't fit in memory
issues.body: Our current API requires the entire dataset to be loaded in memory. Add support for generators and memory‑mapped files.

issues.title: Add SHAP explainability integration
issues.body: Users want to understand model predictions. Integrate SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) and add an `explain()` method to all models.

issues.title: Fix `RuntimeError` on Windows when using multiprocessing
issues.body: The multiprocessing code fails on Windows because it tries to pickle lambdas. Replace with `pathos` or restructure to use callable classes.

issues.title: Add early stopping callback to training loop
issues.body: We currently train for a fixed number of epochs. Implement an early stopping mechanism that monitors validation loss and restores best weights.

issues.title: Improve performance of feature importance calculation
issues.body: The permutation importance method is too slow on large feature sets. Use concurrent futures to parallelise the shuffling.

issues.title: Update deprecated TensorFlow APIs
issues.body: We still use `tf.compat.v1` APIs in several places. Migrate to TensorFlow 2.x idiomatic code.

issues.title: Add type hints to public API functions
issues.body: None of our public methods have type annotations. This makes IDE support poor. Add Python 3.10+ type hints and run `mypy` in CI.

issues.title: Fix incorrect normalization when using `StandardScaler` with sample_weight
issues.body: When sample weights are provided, the standard deviation is computed incorrectly. The mean is correct but the stdev uses unweighted formula.

issues.title: Add support for Apple Silicon (M1/M2) acceleration
issues.body: Our library has no Metal Performance Shaders backend. Investigate `tensorflow-metal` and `torch.backends.mps` for GPU access on Macs.

issues.title: Fix broken link in the API reference
issues.body: The link to `GridSearchCV` in the documentation returns a 404. Update the URL to the stable version.

issues.title: Add a progress bar for long‑running operations
issues.body: Methods like `fit()` and `predict()` can take hours. Add a `verbose` parameter that shows a `tqdm` progress bar.

issues.title: Reduce memory footprint of the `OneHotEncoder`
issues.body: The encoder creates dense arrays even when most values are zero. Switch to a sparse matrix representation for large categorical features.

issues.title: Fix `ValueError` when using `train_test_split` with integer labels
issues.body: When labels are integers, `train_test_split` occasionally raises a ValueError about inconsistent sample sizes. This seems to be a str/categorical mismatch.

issues.title: Add GPU utilisation metrics to the logger
issues.body: We log CPU and memory usage, but GPU stats are missing. Integrate `pynvml` to report GPU utilisation and memory during training.

issues.title: Fix seeding for reproducible results across runs
issues.body: Even with `random_state` set, results differ between runs on different machines. Add explicit seeds for numpy, torch, and TensorFlow globals.

issues.title: Add support for custom loss functions in the high‑level API
issues.body: The `Model` class only accepts predefined loss functions. Allow users to pass a callable or a PyTorch loss module.

issues.title: Speed up `GridSearchCV` with caching
issues.body: Identical fits are repeated unnecessarily. Cache intermediate results when the same estimator/config pair is evaluated.

issues.title: Add `to_markdown()` method for summary tables
issues.body: The `model_summary()` output is not markdown‑friendly. Add a method to export as a proper markdown table for reports and notebooks.

issues.title: Fix `DeprecationWarning` from outdated NumPy API
issues.body: We use `numpy.bool` which is deprecated since NumPy 1.20. Replace with `bool` or `numpy.bool_`.

issues.title: Add integration with MLflow for experiment tracking
issues.body: Users often want to track experiments outside our library. Integrate MLflow to log parameters, metrics, and artifacts automatically.

issues.title: Add `partial_fit` support for incremental learning
issues.body: Our models cannot be updated with new data without full retraining. Implement `partial_fit` for SGD‑based estimators.

issues.title: Fix layout issue in the Jupyter widget for parameter tuning
issues.body: The slider widget for hyperparameters overflows on small screens. Add a responsive layout and a 'reset to default' button.

issues.title: Add `calibration_curve` plotting utility
issues.body: We have no built‑in calibration diagnostics. Add a function that plots reliability diagrams for binary classifiers.

issues.title: Fix memory exhaustion when using `pandas.DataFrame` with large models
issues.body: Passing a DataFrame to `fit()` duplicates the data unnecessarily. Convert to numpy internally before training.

issues.title: Add `feature_importances_` to the linear SVM class
issues.body: Our `LinearSVC` wrapper does not expose feature importance. Compute the absolute magnitude of the coefficients as a proxy.

issues.title: Improve documentation for custom transformer creation
issues.body: The guide for creating custom transformers is sparse. Add a step‑by‑step example and include a template class.

issues.title: Add `save_pretrained()` method to all neural network models
issues.body: Each framework has its own saving mechanism. Unify behind a `save_pretrained()` that works for PyTorch and TensorFlow.

issues.title: Fix `AttributeError` when accessing `classes_` before fitting
issues.body: If you try to access `classes_` before calling `fit()`, you get a cryptic error. Raise a more informative `NotFittedError`.

issues.title: Add support for Python 3.12
issues.body: Our library hasn't been tested on Python 3.12. Update CI, fix any deprecations, and release a compatible wheel.

issues.title: Fix incorrect ROC AUC when using sample weights
issues.body: The `roc_auc_score` function ignores sample weights. Implement a weighted version that matches the sklearn API.

issues.title: Add a benchmark suite with `asv` (airspeed velocity)
issues.body: We lack regression tests for performance. Set up an `asv` benchmark suite that runs on each PR to catch slowdowns.

issues.title: Fix `UserWarning` when using `LabelEncoder` on mixed types
issues.body: When the input contains both strings and numbers, `LabelEncoder` issues a misleading warning. Normalise to strings first.

issues.title: Add dropout support to the MLP classifier
issues.body: Our multi‑layer perceptron does not support dropout, which limits generalisation. Add a `dropout` parameter with sensible default.

issues.title: Improve the error message when `pip install` fails on M1 Mac
issues.body: Many M1 users hit a `RuntimeError: no matching wheel` error. Add platform‑specific install instructions in the error message.

issues.title: Add `n_jobs` parameter to all meta‑estimators
issues.body: Not all estimators expose `n_jobs`. Standardise the parameter across the codebase so users can parallelise consistently.

issues.title: Fix `FutureWarning` from Hugging Face datasets library
issues.body: The `datasets` package has deprecated the `load_dataset` builder argument. Update our inner loop to use the new `data_files` API.

issues.title: Add example for multi‑label classification
issues.body: Our examples only show binary and multi‑class classification. Add a notebook for multi‑label problems using `MultiOutputClassifier`.

issues.title: Fix random seed not respected in PyTorch DataLoader
issues.body: Setting `torch.manual_seed()` does not guarantee deterministic shuffling in the DataLoader. Add a custom `worker_init_fn`.

issues.title: Add `explain_prediction()` method to all models
issues.body: We want model‑agnostic explanations. Implement a method that uses LIME or SHAP to explain individual predictions.

issues.title: Helm chart fails to install on GKE Autopilot
issues.body: Our Helm chart uses `hostNetwork=true` which is not allowed on GKE Autopilot clusters. Replace with standard networking and add node selectors.

issues.title: Terraform plan is too slow on large state files
issues.body: With over 500 resources, `terraform plan` takes 12 minutes. We need to split the state into smaller workspaces or use `-parallelism`.

issues.title: Add automated rollback for failed deployments
issues.body: When a deployment fails, the old version stays dead. Implement a health‑check based rollback in our CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions.

issues.title: Fix Prometheus metrics scraping timeout on high load
issues.body: Under peak load, Prometheus scrapes time out after 15 seconds. Increase `scrape_timeout` and add a dedicated metrics pod.

issues.title: Migrate from Jenkins to GitHub Actions for CI/CD
issues.body: Our Jenkins server is a maintenance burden. Move all pipelines to GitHub Actions with reusable workflows and composite actions.

issues.title: Add OPA policy checks to the deployment pipeline
issues.body: We need to enforce security policies before deployments. Integrate Open Policy Agent with Conftest to validate all Terraform plans and Kubernetes manifests.

issues.title: Fix flaky integration tests in staging environment
issues.body: Several integration tests fail intermittently due to database connection timeouts. Add retries with exponential backoff.

issues.title: Set up cost monitoring dashboard for AWS
issues.body: We have no visibility into cloud spending. Create a Grafana dashboard that queries AWS Cost Explorer and sends alerts on budget thresholds.

issues.title: Rotate leaked AWS access keys automatically
issues.body: When an access key is accidentally committed, we must revoke it manually. Create a Lambda that scans public repos and auto‑rotates compromised keys.

issues.title: Add support for Azure AKS in our deployment scripts
issues.body: Our scripts are AWS‑only. Extend the provisioning module to support AKS with the same interface, using `az` CLI.

issues.title: Fix memory leak in the metrics collector daemon
issues.body: The custom Go daemon that pushes metrics to Prometheus has a memory leak. Profile with `pprof` and fix the unbounded slice growth.

issues.title: Add blue‑green deployment support in Helm chart
issues.body: Our Helm chart only supports rolling updates. Add blue‑green deployment with Istio traffic shifting for zero‑downtime releases.

issues.title: Update base AMI to Amazon Linux 2023
issues.body: We still use Amazon Linux 2, which is nearing EOL. Update the Packer template and test all cookbooks.

issues.title: Fix `kubectl` timeout when applying large manifests
issues.body: Applying a YAML with 2000+ resources times out after 10 minutes. Split the manifest or increase the `kubectl` request timeout.

issues.title: Add network policy to restrict pod‑to‑pod traffic
issues.body: All pods can talk to each other, which is insecure. Write Calico network policies that only allow required communication.

issues.title: Automate SSL certificate renewal with cert‑manager
issues.body: SSL certificates expire every 90 days and are renewed manually. Install cert‑manager to handle ACME challenges and auto‑renew certificates.

issues.title: Fix Terraform state locking issue in S3 backend
issues.body: Occasionally two CI jobs run concurrently and corrupt the state. The DynamoDB lock table is throttled; add provisioned capacity.

issues.title: Add runbook for common production incidents
issues.body: New SREs have no reference for handling common outages. Write runbooks for DB failover, high CPU alerts, and cache eviction scenarios.

issues.title: Reduce container startup time by optimising init scripts
issues.body: Containers take 40 seconds to start because the init script checks all dependencies sequentially. Run checks in parallel.

issues.title: Add canary deployment analysis with Argo Rollouts
issues.body: Our blue‑green deployments don't analyse metrics. Integrate Argo Rollouts to gradually shift traffic while monitoring error rates.

issues.title: Fix log rotation filling up disk on worker nodes
issues.body: Docker logs are not rotated, causing disk pressure on nodes. Configure `log-opts` with size and max‑file limits in the daemon.json.

issues.title: Enable audit logging for Kubernetes API server
issues.body: We have no record of who performed changes. Enable audit logging and ship the logs to CloudWatch for compliance.

issues.title: Add PodSecurityPolicy (or PSS) to harden the cluster
issues.body: Our cluster allows privileged pods by default. Implement restricted Pod Security Standards to prevent host filesystem access and set non‑root users.

issues.title: Fix Helm release drift detection not working
issues.body: The drift detection script relies on `helm diff`, which broke after upgrading to Helm 3.12. Update the plugin and fix the CLI arguments.

issues.title: Add load‑testing framework to the pipeline
issues.body: We have no performance baseline. Add `k6` scripts to run against staging on each release and fail if p95 latency exceeds 500ms.

issues.title: Fix `awscli` version mismatch in the CI worker image
issues.body: The CI pipeline uses an outdated `awscli` that doesn't support `ec2-instance-connect`. Build a new Docker image with version 2.x.

issues.title: Add automated backup verification
issues.body: We take hourly RDS snapshots but never test them. Create a weekly job that restores the latest snapshot, runs a smoke test, and deletes it.

issues.title: Reduce Terraform module duplication across environments
issues.body: Our staging and production modules are 80% identical. Refactor to use a single module with environment‑specific variables.

issues.title: Add OpenID Connect (OIDC) for GitHub Actions to AWS
issues.body: We use long‑lived AWS access keys in GitHub secrets. Switch to OIDC so that tokens are short‑lived and scoped to specific workflows.

issues.title: Fix `kubectl` context not being set in the CI runner
issues.body: Our GitHub Actions runner sometimes loses the kubeconfig context, causing deployment failures. Cache the context between steps.

issues.title: Add multi‑arch Docker images (amd64 + arm64)
issues.body: Our images only support x86_64. Set up `docker buildx` and a multi‑platform CI pipeline to build for ARM64 as well.

issues.title: Fix false positive alerts from synthetic monitoring
issues.body: The health‑check endpoint occasionally returns 503 during deployments, triggering PagerDuty. Add a grace period after each deployment.

issues.title: Set up Vault for secrets management
issues.body: Secrets are stored in encrypted YAML in Git, which is not ideal. Deploy HashiCorp Vault and integrate with the CI pipeline and our apps.

issues.title: Reduce Docker image scan time in CI
issues.body: Trivy scans take 8 minutes because they download the entire vulnerability DB each time. Cache the DB on the GitHub Actions runner.

issues.title: Add Service Level Objectives (SLOs) dashboard
issues.body: We track uptime but not SLOs. Define SLOs for critical APIs and create a Grafana dashboard based on Prometheus recording rules.

issues.title: Fix `terraform destroy` leaving orphaned resources
issues.body: Some resources (DNS records, S3 buckets) are not removed during `terraform destroy` because `prevent_destroy` is set. Review lifecycle policies.

issues.title: Add CLI tool for fleet‑wide health checks
issues.body: SREs SSH into every node to check health. Write a small Go CLI that queries all nodes via SSH and aggregates the results.

issues.title: Improve the onboarding guide for new team members
issues.body: The current guide is a single Markdown file that's out of date. Rewrite it as a set of short, linked documents covering tools and processes.

issues.title: Add support for Kubernetes 1.29 in our tooling
issues.body: Several deprecated APIs (e.g., `extensions/v1beta1`) are removed in 1.29. Update all manifests and CI test matrices.

issues.title: Fix certificate mismatch on internal load balancers
issues.body: The internal ALB presents a wildcard certificate that doesn't match the internal domain. Generate a new certificate for `*.internal.example.com`.

issues.title: Add spot instance support to reduce costs
issues.body: Our worker nodes run on‑demand. Modify the Terraform module to support spot instances with graceful termination handling.

issues.title: Fix ArgoCD sync failures when CRDs are updated
issues.body: ArgoCD fails to sync when a Custom Resource Definition changes. Add a pre‑sync hook that applies CRDs first.

issues.title: Add chaos engineering experiments with LitmusChaos
issues.body: We want to test resilience. Set up LitmusChaos and add experiments for pod deletion, network latency, and CPU stress.

issues.title: Reduce alert fatigue by tuning thresholds
issues.body: Our team received 300 alerts last week, mostly false positives. Analyse historical data and adjust Prometheus alert thresholds.

issues.title: Add support for external DNS with Cloudflare
issues.body: Our DNS is managed via Route53, but some teams use Cloudflare. Extend the external‑dns deployment to support Cloudflare provider.

issues.title: Fix token expiry in the service account controller
issues.body: Service account tokens expire after 1 hour and are not renewed automatically. Switch to projected tokens with a configurable audience and TTL.

issues.title: Add a self‑service namespace provisioning portal
issues.body: Developers must file a Jira ticket to get a Kubernetes namespace. Build a simple web UI backed by a Kubernetes operator that auto‑approves requests.

issues.title: Update all Ansible playbooks to use fully‑qualified collection names
issues.body: The playbooks use short module names that trigger deprecation warnings in Ansible 8. Update to `ansible.builtin.service`, etc.

issues.title: Implement least‑privilege IAM roles for CI/CD
issues.body: Our CI role currently has `AdministratorAccess`. Scopedown to only the necessary actions for each pipeline step.

issues.title: Add automated cluster autoscaling tests
issues.body: We never validate that the cluster scales correctly. Create a script that triggers a load spike and verifies that new nodes join within 5 minutes.
